why: Good news: the teal-poled gate structure is back in view, at the right edge of the forward camera frame - this is the same gate we saw at k=0. The policy's proposed 78-degree right turn plus a 1.1m lateral shove is roughly the right idea (turn right to face the gate, move toward it) but is more aggressive than I want to commit to blind, especially with trust only 0.63. Overriding with a smaller, controlled 40-degree right turn to bring the gate pole toward the center of frame, plus a modest forward/rightward step to close distance, keeping altitude about the same. Using higher sigma now since the policy has a real visual target to servo on.
